hypotheses.C0_targets_are_replicable: The median top-tail threshold changes by less than a factor of two between corpus splits.
hypotheses.C1_contextual_rules_predict_effects: At least four derivative-ranked heads have held-out contextual-tree AUROC at least 0.70.
hypotheses.C2_context_adds_beyond_position_frequenc: At least four derivative-ranked heads gain at least 0.05 AUROC over the position/frequency tree.
hypotheses.C3_relations_add_beyond_static_lexicon: At least three derivative-ranked heads gain at least 0.03 AUROC over source/destination static lexical predicates.
hypotheses.C4_rules_are_split_stable: At least four derivative-ranked heads have selected-predicate Jaccard at least 0.30 across discovery halves.
hypotheses.C5_ranked_heads_are_more_readable: The median contextual AUROC of ranked heads exceeds bottom-eight derivative-importance controls by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.C6_variables_are_reused_by_distinct_func: At least three non-baseline predicates are selected by multiple ranked heads, with median within-predicate absolute OV cosine below 0.20.
